outputs.explanation: Panel A shows photographic images of lungs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence), not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity ± SD with individual data points (blue and red dots for each mouse) overlaid on the bars.
Panel C consists of histology/micrograph images (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial transcriptomics visualizations, not averaged summary plots requiring individual data points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Bar graph showing log2 fold change of M2/TAM genes with p-values annotated, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars to show underlying variability.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
